description: This Java source file defines the BinaryStreamHandler class which implements handling of binary complex data for observations in the OpenMRS system. It manages storing, retrieving, and processing binary data associated with complex observations, specifically for complex obs stored as files on the filesystem.

classes.name: BinaryStreamHandler
classes.description: A handler class for storing and retrieving binary data associated with complex observations, leveraging file system storage.

methods.name: BinaryStreamHandler
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the handler, potentially setting up filename handling for data storage.

methods.name: getObs
methods.description: Retrieves the complex data associated with an observation for a specific view, currently supports raw binary view, and manages filename sanitization.

methods.name: getSupportedViews
methods.description: Returns an array of supported view types for this handler, currently only the RAW_VIEW.

methods.name: saveObs
methods.description: Stores the complex data of an observation into the file system and saves the reference key in the observation.
